newsitem.title: USA: SyQuest restructures $50 million in debt.
newsitem.headline: SyQuest restructures $50 million in debt.

text.p: SyQuest Technology Inc said it renegotiated $50 million in trade debt, strengthening its balance sheet and improving operating stability.

Of the $50 million debt restructuring, $11.5 million was converted to equity by several major suppliers. The remaining $38.5 million in supplier debt was converted to notes payable ranging in duration from 12 to 36 months.
"We continue to make excellent progress toward improving our balance sheet and making SyQuest a stable, healthy company," said Ed Marinaro, chairman.

The $11.5 million debt-to-equity conversion brings total new investment funding for the company to $61.5 million when added to previously announced equity transactions which amounted to $50 million. These steps are the latest in a series of moves by SyQuest's new management to improve operations and rebuild the balance sheet, it said.
Earlier, the company also announced the formation of a proposed joint venture with Legend Group of China.
